label: Family workspace
intro: Choose what you want to do; the small label names the app behind it.

sections.title: Everyday
sections.description: Create, plan, remember, and find the things the household uses most.

services.name: Household AI
services.description: Ask for help with projects, research, pictures, cooking, gardening, travel, and household knowledge.

setup.label: Where to talk to Baloo
setup.intro: Baloo is available in the web chat and in WhatsApp. Different WhatsApp conversations route to the most useful specialist.
steps: Open the web chat from this card, or message Baloo in WhatsApp.
Use a private Baloo chat for general help; use the Cooking, Garden, or Trips group for that specialist.
You can attach pictures directly in WhatsApp when you want Baloo to inspect them.

services.name: Files & shared documents
services.description: Store, share, edit, and sync household files and collaborative documents.

services.name: Pictures & albums
services.description: Browse, search, back up, and share the family photo and video library.

setup.label: Set up automatic phone backup
steps: Install the Immich app on your phone.
Set the server address to https://photos.newjoy.ro and sign in with your household account.
Choose the phone albums you want to back up and allow background photo access.

services.name: Household paperwork
services.description: Find scanned records, receipts, manuals, warranties, and other paperwork in one searchable archive.

services.name: Recipes & meal planning
services.description: Keep recipes, make meal plans, and build shared shopping lists.

services.name: Trips & holidays
services.description: Collect bookings, build itineraries, manage packing, and track travel expenses.

setup.label: Use it with Baloo
steps: Open the trip planner here when you want the full itinerary and trip details.
In the Trips WhatsApp group, ask Baloo to research places, help with plans, or record shared trip expenses.

services.name: Household budget
services.description: Review spending, accounts, categories, and the household tracking budget.

services.name: Tasks & projects
services.description: Capture tasks, organize projects, and keep shared to-do lists moving.

sections.title: Personal & private
sections.description: Passwords, communication, and identity. Each capability also has its own protected account.

services.name: Passwords & secure notes
services.description: Store passwords securely and fill them into websites and phone apps without memorising or reusing them.

setup.label: Install apps & browser autofill
steps: Install Bitwarden Password Manager on your phone and the Bitwarden extension in every desktop browser you use.
Before signing in, choose the self-hosted server option and enter https://vault.newjoy.ro as the server URL.
Sign in with your household vault account, then enable biometric unlock and autofill on each device.
Once Bitwarden autofill works, turn off password saving in the browser to avoid duplicate prompts.

services.name: Email
services.description: Read and send Newjoy mail from a browser.

services.name: Account & sign-in
services.description: Manage passkeys, profile details, signed-in sessions, and account activity.

setup.label: Add a passkey on this device
steps: Open your account and add a passkey for the phone or computer you are using.
Keep more than one passkey when possible so losing one device does not lock you out.
Review active sessions and remove devices you no longer use.

sections.title: Home & entertainment
sections.description: Control the house from anywhere, watch the family library, and check cameras. Media playback still needs the home network or WireGuard.

services.name: Smart home
services.description: Control lights and devices, check sensors, and run scenes and automations. This service does not use your Pocket ID sign-in.

setup.label: Install the phone app
steps: Install the Home Assistant Companion app on your phone.
Home Assistant uses its own account, separate from the Pocket ID account that signs you into this portal.
Nabu Casa Cloud provides encrypted remote access when you are away; at home you can also use the direct local address.
Allow notifications and location only if you want home alerts or presence-based automations.

services.name: Movies, TV & music
services.description: Watch the household media library on phones, computers, and televisions.

setup.label: Install Emby on a device
steps: Install the Emby app on your phone, tablet, television, or streaming device.
Connect to the home Wi-Fi or travel WireGuard and add http://192.168.1.204:8096 as the server.
Sign in with your personal Emby account so watch progress and favourites stay separate.

services.name: Cameras & detections
services.description: See live cameras, recent detections, and recorded events.
